title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 24 October 2026
description: OpenAI nears a $30 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of a possible IPO, the UN warns Chevron over methane plumes at its Gorgon gas project, the Rugby League World Cup kicks off across Queensland venues, and the Gold Coast 500 draws huge crowds to Surfers Paradise. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
